# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/thomasbuilds/Spectre/security/advisories/new), not in a public issue.

Include the Spectre version, your device and Android version, and the steps to reproduce.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Verifying a release

Release APKs are signed with the certificate whose SHA-256 fingerprint is published in [CERT.sha256](https://github.com/thomasbuilds/Spectre/blob/main/CERT.sha256). An APK signed with any other certificate did not come from this project.
